overview: File tracks a ship's transfer from US to Panamanian to reported Japanese registry, and Costa Rica's 1941 cancellation of a Japanese fishing vessel's registration.

people.name: Claude G. Bowers
people.role: U.S. Ambassador to Chile and apparent sender of the referenced despatch

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to despatch on transfer of the S.S. Atlantico’s registry
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to despatch no. 871 concerning the transfer of the S.S. Atlantico from U.S. to Panamanian and reportedly Japanese registry.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: a naval report notes the S.S. Atlantico's transfer from US to Panamanian, then reportedly Japanese, registry.

subfiles.title: Naval Attaché message on cancellation of the Amano’s Costa Rican registration
subfiles.about: The message reports Costa Rica’s cancellation of the registration of the Japanese fishing vessel Amano at Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Naval attaché reports Costa Rica canceled the Japanese fishing vessel Amano's registration in September 1941.

subfiles.title: Strictly confidential departmental copy of the Amano registration message
subfiles.about: This filing copy repeats the report that Costa Rica cancelled the Amano’s registration at Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Confidential copy duplicates the report that Costa Rica canceled the Japanese fishing vessel Amano's registration at Puntarenas.

interest: Shows 1940-41 US tracking of Japanese-linked ship registry changes in Latin America amid rising wartime scrutiny.
